title: Migration authorship
text: Migrations and *_schema.py modules depend on the explicit schema_storage, persistence_queries and payload_validators allow-list, plus listed migration infrastructure helpers, stdlib, psycopg and yoke_contracts. Storage constants come from their schema owner; live orchestration, gates and domain invariants stay above storage and pass required data in. Applied entries cannot be edited, including imports; corrections use a new entry and baseline squashing removes historical scripts while retaining released identity evidence. The import guard checks every domain *_schema.py and entries after 0106, including lazy and relative imports. Historical entries through 0106 and two owner-specific existing schema edges retain explicit exceptions. A violation names the path, line, forbidden module, allowed layers and recovery: move policy to orchestration and pass data into the migration/schema.
